The '''Seylott system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seylott/Legends|Seylott]], which was part of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] from circa [[30,000 BBY]] to [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
